newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-market oats, cuts daily wheat tax.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-market oats, cuts daily wheat tax.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export around 5,000 tonnes of free-market Swedish and Finnish oats for export to third countries, except Switzerland and Liechtenstein, at a maximum rebate of 21.89 Ecus per tonne, EU grain officials said.
Bids to exports Finnish and Swedish oats to Switzerland and Liechtenstein were rejected, they said.

The EU also cut the tax applying to daily soft wheat grain exports to five Ecus per tonne from a previous level of 15 Ecus, and the tax applying to daily exports of soft wheat flour to seven Ecus per tonne from 20 Ecus, officials said.
The EU granted a maximum tariff cut of 59.77 Ecus per tonne for 328,703 tonnes of prefential maize imports to Spain, member country officials said.
The awards are part of a scheme to allow preferential maize imports to Spain from the United States under a 1987 trade pact.
